data.one_liner: Animated overflow text widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Shows text that overflows with animated scrolling or other effects. It is a stateful widget that animates the text when it exceeds its width.
use_when: Need animated overflow text in a UI
Want custom animation for long text
Need a simple widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: Parent widget does not specify a width
You only need static overflow handling
strengths: Easy to use with minimal configuration
Supports multiple animation types, curves, durations and delays
weaknesses: Requires parent to have a specified width
No documentation on multiline or complex layouts
data.minimal_example:
OverflowTextAnimated(
  text: overflowText,
  style: descriptionStyle,
  curve: Curves.fastEaseInToSlowEaseOut,
  animation: OverFlowTextAnimations.scrollOpposite,
  animateDuration: Duration(milliseconds: 1500),
  delay: Duration(milliseconds: 500),
)
